levels.name: Dreams of the Foamy Deep
levels.description: The CRIT Rate of Pressurized Floe: Shattering Pressure will be increased by 15%.

levels.name: Penguins and the Land of Plenty
levels.description: Unleashing Pressurized Floe: Shattering Pressure will restore 2 Energy to Freminet. If a Pressure Level 4 Shattering Pressure is unleashed, this will restore 3 Energy.

levels.name: Song of the Eddies and Bleached Sands
levels.description: Increases the Level of Normal Attack: Flowing Eddies by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Dance of the Snowy Moon and Flute
levels.description: After Freminet triggers Frozen, Shatter, or Superconduct against opponents, his ATK will be increased by 9% for 6s. Max 2 stacks. This can be triggered once every 0.3s.

levels.name: Nights of Hearth and Happiness
levels.description: Increases the Level of Pressurized Floe by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Moment of Waking and Resolve
levels.description: After Freminet triggers Frozen, Shatter, or Superconduct against opponents, his CRIT DMG will be increased by 12% for 6s. Max 3 stacks. This can be triggered once every 0.3s.
